title: Communication Intern
summary: Help share SKF’s work and connect people with stories of inclusion and community impact.
responsibilities: Drafting social media content and programme updates.
Organising photographs and stories from SKF activities.
Preparing simple communication materials with the team.
skills: Clear writing, attention to detail, and an interest in social media or visual communication.

title: HR Intern
summary: Support the people and administrative work that helps SKF’s team serve communities.
responsibilities: Organising HR records and routine documentation under supervision.
Supporting attendance records and internal communication.
skills: Organisation, discretion, clear communication, and confidence using documents and spreadsheets.

title: Finance Intern
summary: Help the finance team maintain organised records that support SKF’s programmes.
responsibilities: Organising receipts, vouchers, and supporting documents.
Updating spreadsheets and assisting with routine checks.
Preparing financial records for review under supervision.
skills: Accuracy, spreadsheet skills, confidentiality, and an interest in accounting or financial administration.
